action: The horn blasts, sound rings and snow spread outward over the ground, the falcons circle and call, in a rousing loop. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
seedPrompt: GREAT HUNT: a carved bone hunting horn with bronze bands blasting, rings of sound and swirling snow spreading out low over the ground in a wide ellipse seen from an elevated three-quarter view, silhouettes of three falcons circling above, pine branches swaying. Palette: frost off-white, glacier blue, slate grey, pine green, muted aurora teal, leather brown, antique bronze. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no soft gradients, no blur, few large readable shapes. Norse winter folk style: carved wood and stone, pine and birch, falcon feathers, fur and leather, bronze, physical snow and ice (not glowing crystal). NOT anime, no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no letters, no runes, no text, no Viking horned helmets, no valknut, no religious or political symbols, no wolves, no character, no person, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side. Whites are frost off-white, never pure white.
